notes: Processed parts 16-20 (50 groups) into 52 rows. Merged groups 'montgomery countys clean energy' and 'bethesda based centrus energy' into one Centrus Energy row (public company). Expanded two groups into extra rows: 'homeward' (Series D equity plus a separate $330M asset-backed debt facility) and 'quartermaster' (Series B plus a separate $40M Stifel venture debt facility); the KrASIA 'deals in brief' round-up yielded a Salmon row plus a low-confidence Salary Hero Series A row (no figure in the title; the four unnamed China investments were not expanded). Used 25 web lookups (WebSearch/WebFetch), highest amounts first: Scanntech, Reverion, Matchpoint, Ledgebrook, Inferact, Souffle, Nouscom, Homeward, General Medicine, Jeeves, Estuary, Quartermaster, Universal Quantum, Aureka, Techloy round-up, Blackwall, Rainmaker homepage (AI check), Matchpoint homepage (AI check), Blackwall homepage (AI check); fetches of fiercehealthcare.com, fiercebiotech.com and mobihealthnews.com returned HTTP 403, so General Medicine and Estuary keep hq_city null. For rows where the part file had no article text, evidence spans are quoted from the fetched publisher page or the search-result summary listed in source_urls. Lookups showed several groups are stale re-coverage of rounds announced outside the window: Inferact (2026-01-22), Aureka (2026-08-10), Reverion (2026-09-29), Jeeves (2026-09-29/30), Quartermaster (2026-09-28); the first two are marked exclude_reason 'duplicate', the late-September ones are kept with their real announced_date. The Ledgebrook group's attached article text is a June 2025 Series C story; the October 2026 round is a $200M primary equity financing (UK syndicated copy converted it to 'over GBP 150 million'). Unresolved: the Techloy 'Africa & Middle East Startup Funding Week 41' round-up (2026 edition not found in search, only the 2025 edition) is emitted as a placeholder row with exclude_reason 'not-funding' and no deals expanded; Revalue Energies' country is unknown. Debt facilities raised by the operating company itself (DailyPay, NorthStar, Pivot Energy, VIVA, EZO, EarnIn, QumulusAI, Unison, Sophos) are kept as Debt rows without exclude_reason; third-party real-estate and project loans (MONTICELLOAM, Terra, Barings/Hillwood, Revalue), contract awards, ARR milestones and interviews are marked 'not-funding'. Helion's CHIPS LOI is kept as a Grant row (proposed, not closed; see its confidence). EUR converted at 1.10.
